items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I did a short for him somewhere

ctx.x: Is he a New York person?

Well, he -- I did a short for him somewhere, and he came in Basin Street when we were making this thing -- when we were playing there -- and I thought he'd flipped his cookies, you know. He said, "I'm going to do this," and I was staying across the street at the Waldorf and he was calling there, and I told my wife, I said, "Please don't, I'm not here," when he calls, the man's insane. He wants to make an hour and 15 minutes of a band sitting there playing, in color, wide screen, stereophonic sound." And finally I…
The band must have sounded good.
